audience: Head of a ministry ICT unit · service owner's project lead · counterpart to the supplier

videos.title: Four questions decided once for every screen
videos.message: How officers pick, find, move and act is settled for the whole application in one document you accept.

videos.title: No list longer than nine: choose by category
videos.message: A long list is divided into categories, and the officer picks the category first.

videos.title: The service workflow: states, moves and who may make each
videos.message: Every state a case can be in, every move between states, and who may make each move, written once.

videos.title: One file a program reads: the application model
videos.message: Everything agreed is carried into one file, from which the application is generated.

videos.title: Reviewing the model: what it assumed, and what it could not express
videos.message: Every assumption and every loss is named for a person to rule on.

videos.title: Refused, not worked around
videos.message: A program refuses a description that contradicts what you accepted, and nobody switches the check off.
